preconditions.description: The height of the grid must be between 2 and 1000.
The width of the grid must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of days must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid must have a length equal to the width of the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in '.#' for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either '.' or '#'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= h and 1 <= ci <= w for ri, ci in temp_blocks)
preconditions.description: All temporarily blocked cells must be within the grid boundaries.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether the day is interesting.
The output must be exactly three characters long, including the newline character.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if path_exists(grid, temp_blocks) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must correctly indicate if Limak can reach the school and return home without revisiting cells.
